Name: CiriunAlleyKitsu's Dodos Plus for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions for the authors of this one were open, so I present Dodos Plus for SDV 1.6. Credit to Kitsunesune for the original artwork, Ciriun for the first version of the BFAV mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5835?tab=description]here[/url]), and AlleyBalley28 for the second, plus-version ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18759]here[/url]).  

﻿Dodos live in coops and lay eggs that can be turned into mayo.

Enjoy!
